news.message:
Rules are updated!
  • Change the deadline of Team Reference Document (TRD) to October 24, 2026, 23:59 WIB.
  • There will be 45-55 teams from all provincials to advance to The 2026 ICPC Regional Asia Jakarta.
  • Allow the programming language Kotlin to be used in the competition.
  • Replace the Python interpreter with PyPy.
  • Add a FAQ regarding auto-complete.

REGISTRATION EXTENDED! Only 2 days left to register for Indonesia National Contest 2026! 🔥

Good news! We’ve extended the registration period, so you still have time to gather your team and secure your spot in one of the biggest programming contests!
